# JaegerGRS.com

Independent IT and development portfolio by Jaeger G.R. Stratton.

**Live URL:** https://jaegergrs.com/
**Hosting:** Cloudflare Worker `jaegergrs-portfolio` (custom domains `jaegergrs.com`, `www.jaegergrs.com`), serving the `public/` folder as static assets.
**Source:** Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript generated by a dependency-free Node script; the Worker uses `postal-mime` to safely parse inbound email.

## Where things are

```
public/                  Everything that is deployed (what visitors get)
  index.html, 404.html, sitemap.xml, robots.txt
  about/ projects/ expertise/ contact/ changelog/   generated pages
  assets/                styles.css, main.js, boot.js, rig.js, contact.js, inbox.js, inbox.css, favicon, img/
  inbox/                 Private admin inbox page (Worker and Access protected)
  embed/                 rig-embed.js + rig-embed.css: the one-tag Rig API panel

src/
  worker.mjs             Cloudflare Worker: routing, /api/rig, /api/rig/claim, /api/contact and inbound email
  rig-hub.mjs            Durable Object: latest PC snapshot and the site-made pairing key
  guard.mjs              Durable Object: contact-form rate limits
  lib/                   contact/inbox/email handling, Access JWT verification, rig field whitelists, security headers, utilities
  site/                  Page generator (edit content here)
    config.mjs           Version, date and every external URL (Svart, Grey Signal, JaeTheTech, socials)
    components.mjs       Shared HTML: header, footer, SEO tags, helpers
    build.mjs            Writes public/ pages and sitemap.xml
    pages/               One file per page group: home, projects, svart-security,
                         grey-signal, jaethetech, jae, rig-api, hardware, expertise,
                         about, contact, changelog, not-found

agent/                   The PC side of the Rig API
  app/                   RigAgent.cs, build.ps1, icon manifest and version info: the tray app (JaegerRigAgent.exe)
  installer/             WXS source and build-msi.ps1: the per-user Windows installer (JaegerRigAgent-1.0.0.msi)
  rig-agent.mjs          Optional Node version of the agent, also syntax-checked in CI

scripts/                 check-site.mjs, test-worker.mjs, dev.mjs, selfhost.ps1, notes-server.mjs
.github/workflows/       CI checks, tray app build, optional Cloudflare deploy
wrangler.toml            Worker, Durable Objects, D1 inbox, email and static assets config
migrations/              D1 schema for contact inbox and inbound email
CHANGELOG.md             Release notes
LICENSE                  All rights reserved
```

Site map: `/`, `/projects/` (`svart-security/` + `tools/`, `grey-signal/` + `build/`, `channel/`, `jaethetech/` + `personal-ai/`, `jae/` + `engineering/`, `rig-api/` + `install/`, `pricing/`, `what-you-get/`, `hardware/`), `/expertise/` (`hardware/`, `development/`), `/about/` (`journey/`), `/contact/`, `/changelog/`. A project's sub pages live in the same `src/site/pages/<project>.mjs` file as its main page.

Each project page links out to the standalone site it describes. Grey Signal is self-hosted at an open IP over HTTP for now; change `GREY` in `src/site/config.mjs` when it has a domain.

## Editing

Edit `src/site/pages/*.mjs` (content) or `src/site/config.mjs`, then:

```bash
npm run generate   # rebuild public/ pages and sitemap
npm run check      # internal links, sitemap, CSP-unsafe inline styles/scripts
npm test           # Worker headers, redirects, image serving
npm run verify     # all three
npm run dev        # live preview on http://localhost:8790, rebuilds and reloads as you edit
npm run selfhost   # run the whole site and API on this PC only (http://localhost:8787, not exposed to your network)
npm run notes      # private page to jot change requests for Copilot Chat (password in notes/.password)
```

Do not hand-edit the generated `.html` files; commit them together with the source change (CI fails if they are out of date). Styles and scripts live directly in `public/assets/`.

### Conventions

- **Colour themes:** the site is grey, black and white. Each project page sets a `theme` (`t-svart`, `t-grey`, `t-jae`, `t-ae`, `t-hw`, `t-rig`) which only changes the accent colour variables at the top of `public/assets/styles.css`.
- **Shared blocks:** use the helpers in `src/site/components.mjs` (`hero`, `facts`, `steps`, `faq`, `more`, `backTo`, `cta`, `img`) instead of writing the HTML by hand.
- **New page:** add it to a file in `src/site/pages/`, import that file in `src/site/build.mjs` if it is new, add the URL to the list in `scripts/test-worker.mjs`, then run `npm run verify`.
- **Security:** no inline styles or scripts and no third-party hosts; the Content Security Policy in `src/lib/security.mjs` blocks them and a test fails if one is added.
- Formatting rules are in `.editorconfig` (UTF-8, LF, two-space indent).

## Deploy to Cloudflare

Cloudflare Pages Git integration returned `8000011` for this account, so production is a Worker deployed with Wrangler.

1. Create a scoped API token with **Workers Scripts Edit**. Never commit it.
2. Add repository secrets `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.
3. Set the Actions variable `CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_ENABLED` to `true`.
4. Push to `main`; the workflow validates and deploys.

Until step 3 is done, pushing to GitHub does not change the live site.

### Live PC panel and contact form

Both are Worker routes (`src/worker.mjs`) backed by Durable Objects.

- **Live PC panel** (`GET/POST /api/rig`): the PC app in [agent/](agent/README.md) posts with a secret pairing key. Easiest: set the Cloudflare variable `RIG_SETUP=open`, press **Get key from site** in `JaegerRigAgent.exe`, then delete the variable (the site makes and remembers the key; `rotate` replaces it). Or set your own with `npx wrangler secret put RIG_TOKEN` (32+ characters; `node agent/rig-agent.mjs --gen-token`), which takes priority.
- **Rig API embed** (`public/embed/rig-embed.js`): add `<script src="/embed/rig-embed.js" defer></script>` to any page for a self-building live panel. The product page is `/projects/rig-api/` (made for small sites and servers only).
- **Contact form and inbox**: form submissions are stored in the Cloudflare D1 inbox and send notifications to `CONTACT_TO`. The private inbox at `/inbox/` verifies Cloudflare Access JWTs in the Worker; it supports reading, replying, archiving/restoring and deleting conversations. Incoming mail can be routed to the Worker by Cloudflare Email Routing; attachments are rejected. The D1 database and schema are provisioned, but the Worker feature is not live until Access, sender verification and (for inbound messages) Email Routing are configured and the Worker is deployed. Follow [docs/EMAIL-INBOX-SETUP.md](docs/EMAIL-INBOX-SETUP.md). Do not change MX records without approval.
- **Email sending**: the existing Cloudflare Email Service binding sends notifications and replies. Verify `CONTACT_FROM` (`website@jaegergrs.com`) in the Cloudflare dashboard before expecting delivery; a production send previously returned 502 because the sender was unverified.
- Optional: `npx wrangler secret put GUARD_SALT` with a cryptographically random secret (at least 32 bytes) to salt the hashed visitor keys used for rate limiting.

Local testing: put `RIG_TOKEN=...` in `.dev.vars` (git-ignored) and run `npx wrangler dev`.

## Security

The Worker adds a strict CSP (no inline scripts or styles, `form-action 'self'`), HSTS, COOP, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, redirects `www` to the apex and serves `/.well-known/security.txt`. API routes are `no-store` with a locked-down CSP. The contact form checks the request origin, caps body size, uses a honeypot, strips header-injection characters and rate-limits per visitor (3 per 10 minutes, 8 per day). The PC key is compared in constant time and only whitelisted hardware fields are ever published.
